map.朔望月周期约为 29.53 天。从新月到满月为\"上弦\"阶段（渐盈），从满月到: The synodic month is about 29.53 days. From new moon to full moon is the "waxing" phase; from full moon to new moon is the "waning" phase. Moon age is the number of days since the last new moon: 0 is new moon and about 14.76 is full moon.

map.视星等（Apparent Magnitude）是衡量天体亮度的一个指标，数值越小: Apparent magnitude measures the brightness of a celestial object: the smaller the value, the brighter it is. A difference of 1 magnitude is a brightness ratio of about 2.512; a difference of 5 magnitudes is exactly 100. Magnitudes can be negative: the Sun (-26.74) is about 398,000 times brighter than the full Moon (-12.74).

map.基于 Pi-Group scaling law 简化公式：先计算撞击动能 E =: Based on a simplified Pi-group scaling law: the impact kinetic energy E = 0.5 × m × v² is computed first, then the final crater diameter is estimated from empirical relations. Real crater size also depends on strata, rock type and atmospheric deceleration, so results are for educational reference only.

map.UTM（Universal Transverse Mercator）投影将地球分: The Universal Transverse Mercator projection divides the Earth into 60 zones, each 6° wide. Positions inside a zone are given as easting (500000 m at the central meridian) and northing (0 at the equator). UTM coordinates are widely used in mapping, GPS navigation and military maps.

map.极昼和极夜发生在纬度高于 66.5°（北极圈/南极圈）的区域。当太阳直射点到达北: Polar day and polar night occur above 66.5° latitude (the Arctic and Antarctic Circles). When the subsolar point reaches the Tropic of Cancer (23.5°N, the June solstice), the Arctic has polar day while the Antarctic has polar night. Solar declination = 23.5° × sin(2π × (N-81)/365), where N is the day of the year.
